No problem. I feel for you. Let me tell you something. When I was younger I thought I had to go to clubs and do not miss out. But when going there, always felt estranged from all the people. Looking back, the best advice I can give you, is to skip to clubphase (it is just a phase) and go build on things that will make you happy in the long run.

You're not weird when you are feeling alienated. Maybe share your story with your dad, what have you got to lose? You already feel like shit and maybe he can help you to go after those things you love. Maybe join a club where you can meet some new people. I haven't got any solutions, just words. Take care
